brief_summary: TQ-F3083 capsule is a new type inhibitor of DPP-IV, which is currently a very effective target for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus at clinical. In addition, it can promote insulin secretion with low potential toxicity, and half-life is shorter than Linagliptin.
brief_title: Study of TQ-F3083 Capsules in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
